local_doc: Local AVR-X1400H overlay, deep-merged over protocol_profile.json at load time (dicts merge key by key, every other value replaces). Keep upstream's file untouched; see LOCAL_MODS.md.

sound_mode_genre_commands.doc: Local: the AVR-X1400H enters the Pure group with 'AUTO' selected via MSAUTO; PURE and PURE DIRECT are ignored as group commands.

quick_select_audio.doc: Local: Quick Select recalls and Amp Assign changes re-read the Audyssey reference level (the AVR-X1400H does not push it).

quick_select_input_mode.doc: Local: a source change re-reads the input mode (SD).

channel_levels_signal.doc: Local: the receiver reports channel levels (CV) only while an audio signal plays (no signal: just CVEND). Re-read them when the input signal changes, and once more after the HDMI handshake.
